---
title: "Cell-cycle scoring"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(gprofiler2)
  library(ggplot2)
})

obj <- readRDS(file.path("results", "processed_combined_obj.rds"))
fig_dir <- "figures"
```

```{r}
s_genes_human <- cc.genes$s.genes
g2m_genes_human <- cc.genes$g2m.genes

s_genes_mouse <- gorth(
  s_genes_human,
  source_organism = "hsapiens",
  target_organism = "mmusculus"
)$ortholog_name

g2m_genes_mouse <- gorth(
  g2m_genes_human,
  source_organism = "hsapiens",
  target_organism = "mmusculus"
)$ortholog_name

obj <- CellCycleScoring(
  obj,
  s.features = s_genes_mouse,
  g2m.features = g2m_genes_mouse,
  set.ident = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
p_cell_cycle <- DimPlot(
  obj,
  group.by = "Phase",
  split.by = "stim_facet",
  pt.size = 0.8
) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

p_cell_cycle
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure1C_cell_cycle.png"), p_cell_cycle,
       width = 13, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
saveRDS(obj, file.path("results", "processed_combined_obj_cellcycle.rds"))
```
